nom: RoC Derm Correxion Eye Repair Dark Circle Eye Cream

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe sensitive skin, or eyes that usually water and redden with creams, report this product absorbed without irritation and felt gentle, though one sensitive user still experienced burning after repeated nightly use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s and 70s and those citing fine lines/aging report brighter, plumper, smoother under-eyes and a more youthful look with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and an aged appearance report smoother, plumper, more youthful-looking under-eye skin; one wished it did more specifically for fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers describe the cream as hydrating and non-greasy, leaving under-eyes feeling moisturized and refreshed rather than dry or tight.
concerns.redness: One reviewer prone to redness/watering around the eyes from creams reports no such reaction with this product.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers note no irritation and compatibility with contact lenses and makeup; however multiple others report burning, stinging, or severe irritation, especially with daily/twice-daily use, improving when frequency was reduced.
concerns.spots: Not addressed by reviewers; comments focus on dark circles and discoloration rather than isolated spots.
concerns.blemishes: Not discussed in these reviews; no reviewer reports acne or blemish-related effects.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the formula as lightweight and non-greasy, with no reports of increased oiliness or shine.

aspects.libelle: Irritation or burning with frequent use
Slow or no visible results for some

extraits.texte: After a week of use, it caused severe irritation under my eyes! I don't recommend it at all

I have suffered from dark circles under my eyes for years. I chalk it up to being a busy mom with kids, getting older and not sleeping as great as I used to in my younger days, and just the added stress of working and being an adult. I started out using this eye repair cream every night after my shower. By about the third night it started to burn a bit when I applied it. So I switched to using the cream every other night and I have not had any issues. I have only used it a little over a week, but I think the dark circles have lightened in appearance.

I recieved this product as a free sample. I was a bit nervous to try it because my eyes are sensitive and tend to water and get red when I put any kind of cream or lotion near them but this one didn't do that. It went on smooth and absorbed quickly without feeling greasy or gross. It felt very refreshing on the skin and within a week my dark circles were lightening. I cant wait to see how much better they look in a month or two. Definitely will buy when I run out !

I was fortunate enough to receive RoC Derm Correxion Eye Repair Dark Circle Cream for free in exchange for my honest review, and after using it consistently for a few weeks, I can confidently say that it has worked wonders on my under-eye area! First, let's talk about the packaging: the sleek, easy-to-use tube is perfect for precise application. The cream itself is lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue, which is a big plus for me since I wear makeup daily. The result was amazing. After using it for a few days, I noticed a visible improvement in the appearance of my dark circles. The skin under my eyes looked brighter and more refreshed, and the fine lines seemed smoother, giving my eyes a more awake and youthful look. What I love most is that it's gentle on my sensitive skin but still effective – a perfect balance that's hard to come by in eye creams!

I appreciated that the texture of this cream is rich without feeling overly heavy or greasy, and it sinks in fairly well, leaving the under-eye area feeling moisturized. After a week or so of daily use, I noticed a modest brightening of the skin under my eyes – the "tired" look was slightly less pronounced. However, the darkest, stubborn circles didn't fade fully, and I think the success depends a lot on what's causing the discoloration (e.g. genetics, pigmentation, blood vessels). One downside: the packaging is a bit finicky – sometimes the tip doesn't dispense smoothly, and a small amount gets wasted or needs extra effort to get out. Overall, I'd say it's a solid product for mild dark circles, especially as a preventative or maintenance cream, but it might not be dramatic enough for those needing strong correction.

This product feels so good to use in the morning to wake up my eyes before I go to the gym. I am 71 years old and have been using Roc products for about 5 years. no one believes I am my actual age. Just this week a young lady said...you are NOT 71, I would have guessed fifties. I don't really have dark circles very often unless unusually tired.

I have mild to moderate dark circles under my eyes. Partially genetics. Partially lack of sleep. But once I started using this eye cream I noticed a brighter under eye. The dark circles have slowly faded giving a more radiant rested appearance. The only thing that would make this eye cream another notch up is help with the appearance of fine lines. But one solution at a time I guess. It wells wear under makeup. Is very hydrating. I really like it!
